set.body:
Scope: atlas, spatial, surface-view-connectivity, surface examples/fixtures and build aggregates.

Deliverable: Use public neurosurf4s APIs for anatomical routing and display; keep only thin ScalaFIM connectivity/fMRI integrations. Keep atlas integration temporary until A1; retain only functional/latent spatial composition in ScalaFIM after the surface cutover. Move shared fixture ownership with the implementation.

Acceptance:
- Atlas/spatial/connectivity and linked volume/surface cursor workflows compile and pass their applicable JVM/JS scenarios.
- All four display implementations, neuro-surface core and extracted surface/hybrid spatial implementations are removed from ScalaFIM after caller cutover.
- No copied fixtures/testkit dependency creates a provider back-edge; known external callers and example entrypoints are migrated.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
